title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF Lesotho achieved transformative progress in child rights through evidence-based programming, innovative research, and strategic partnerships with government, private sector, and academia. Key achievements included improved vaccination coverage, drought response, expanded education access, and enhanced child protection services, ensuring no child was left behind.
